note: Reference output provided by challenge reviewers. RegLoop should produce equivalent or more detailed results.

obligations.obligation: Maintain documented ICT risk management procedures
obligations.gap: Policy mentions a 'framework' but lacks documented procedures, specific scope, and mandatory language
No mention of identifying or classifying critical ICT systems

obligations.obligation: Define ownership responsibilities for ICT risk
obligations.gap: ICT Risk Team is mentioned but ownership responsibilities are not formally defined
Policy says 'periodically' — no annual frequency defined
Documentation 'should be retained whenever practical' — not mandatory, no retention period
No escalation procedures defined in any policy

obligations.obligation: Review critical ICT vendors at least annually
obligations.gap: Review frequency not defined — 'periodically' does not satisfy annual requirement
No evidence or documentation requirement mentioned in vendor policy
No named owner or responsible role defined for vendor oversight
Policy says concerns 'may be escalated when appropriate' — no defined escalation path or trigger
Policy says the organisation 'shall maintain an incident response process' but no procedures are documented
No testing requirement mentioned anywhere in the incident response policy
No evidence or record-keeping requirement for any testing activities
Policy says 'lessons learned may be documented after major incidents' — not mandatory, not required for all incidents

sample_pr.regulatory_citation: DORA ICT Risk Governance Requirements – Annual Risk Reviews
sample_pr.current_text: Critical vendors shall be periodically reviewed.
sample_pr.proposed_text: Critical vendors shall be reviewed at least once every 12 months. Reviews shall assess security posture, operational resilience, and service availability. Evidence of each review shall be documented and retained for a minimum of three years. The Head of Vendor Risk (Procurement) is the accountable owner for ensuring reviews are completed on schedule.
